capital_allocation_activity: We cannot guarantee that our share repurchase program will be fully consummated or that it will enhance long-term shareholder value.
Although our Board of Directors has authorized the share repurchase program, the program does not obligate us to repurchase any specific dollar amount or to acquire any specific number of shares.

governance_notes: Recent 8-K filings include governance and board composition updates.
